patthana22.13:1.1: Nakusalaṃ naniyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo niyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi. Nakusalaṃ
patthana22.13:2.1: naaniyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato aniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Naabyākataṃ naaniyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato aniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Naakusalaṃ naaniyyānikañca naabyākataṃ naaniyyānikañca dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato aniyyāniko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā tīṇi.
